name: CSGOPremier Inventory Value
description: Adds a "Get my inventory value" button to the CSGOPremier inventory page, shows the price change on "Sell to Market", adds "Price" and "Float" sort options, a "Sellable" tab, match and lobby-invite auto-accept, opening several cases at once, float/pattern badges (inventory and market), float/price filters and market pattern and rare-item filters, a price sort on the Trade-Up page, and match details above the clip on the Overwatch review page.
